bounding_box_specification.exemption_logic: Spatial validation pipelines (e.g. scripts/validate_data.py, tests/test_coords_guard.py) must exempt entities having attributes.external_gateway == True from intra-provincial BBOX rejection, preserving authentic real-world GPS coordinates [10.7407, 106.6186] in Ho Chi Minh City.

rule_definition.spatial_indexing: Categorized under regional transport hubs connecting Ho Chi Minh City gateway to Mekong Delta destinations.

external_gateway_rule.rationale: Bến xe Miền Tây is the primary interprovincial transit gateway connecting Ho Chi Minh City to Vĩnh Long. Setting coordinates to [10.7407, 106.6186] with external_gateway=true prevents exclusion by local bounding box filters while maintaining geospatial truth.

specification_rules: 1. Multi-point representation: Itineraries derive spatial geometry from ordered stops attributes.stops[i] referencing valid content entities.
2. Single-point catalog anchor: For catalog views, search ranking, and single-point map clustering, coordinates is set to Stop 1 departure origin coordinates (stops[0].coordinates).
3. Route polyline computation: Map views render the sequence of stop coordinates as an ordered geographic polyline, optimized via corridor projection (agent/itineraries/itinerary_optimizer.py).
4. Bounding box verification: All stops along the route must satisfy intra-provincial Mekong BBox (lat [9.0, 11.0], lng [105.0, 107.0]), except when explicitly linked to an external transit gateway.
